notes.title: Slumberer's Universe has now been released!
notes.notes: [h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]Right now, the full game of Slumberer's Universe has finally been released! After over four years of development, I can confidently say the game has been finished at last. I've worked hard for this moment, and it is an enormous event for me. I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I have enjoyed making this game. The game will take about 8 - 11 hours to play through.[/p][p][/p][p]For those who had previously played the demo, many improvements have been made to the overall game experience, as well as the first chapter, so you can expect an even more polished experience with the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't played the demo yet, but are interested in the game, go try that out! You can play the prologue AND the first chapter for free with the demo, and you can even continue playing with you demo's save file in the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now, I have nothing else to say. I hope you are interested in Slumberer's Universe, and that this game can genuinely impact you. Thank you for reading! [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest update: Demo 1.7 and full game release date reveal!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! The Steam Next Fest has begun today, and there's a bunch of information regarding Slumberer's Universe I've got to share.[/p][p][/p][h1]Full game release - Aug 20, 2025[/h1][p][/p][p]First of all, Slumberer's Universe is releasing in about two months, on August 20! There's a new trailer released, announcing the release date:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="IovVU54gjjE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The full game will feature chapters 1 to 4, plus the prologue. The story will be finally completed after all these years! Will Alph be able to overcome Walter's death? What is the memory he cannot remember? How is all this connected? Find out the truth and uncover the memories Alph wanted to erase in the later chapters! I am very excited for you to be able to play it, so please look forward to the release!![/p][p][/p][p]The game still requires the final levels of polish – mainly some accessibility options, but the game has already entered content lock and the private playtesting has begun. I am so, so happy to have reached this point in the development.[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, the game won't have any localization on launch. The Finnish translation from the demo has been removed too, since it takes too much time to maintain it. I hope I can get this game localized to some languages afterwards though, but no promises regarding that.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]The demo - update 1.7 is now released![/h1][p][/p][p]This new version fixes some remaining bugs, adds graphical improvements and features some additional content in the story. This new update will feature the exact (or almost the) same versions of the first two chapters as in the upcoming full game, so you can see whether you like the game before buying it. You can also load your demo save in the full game and continue playing where you left off when the full game releases.[/p][p][/p][p][spoiler]"I've got nothing to say here this time"        -Ralph[/spoiler][/p]

notes.title: "Death is a Debt" - the next chapter of Slumberer's Universe
notes.notes:
[h2]Chapter 3 and what’s next[/h2]


[h1]Another year has passed, another teaser has come[/h1]
[h3]
Just like last year, here’s a teaser for the next chapter![/h3]

[previewyoutube=MIfVw9YPO5U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]More to talk[/h3]

It’s been a year of radio silence. The game, however, is far from abandoned. The rest of the chapters are coming up nicely, and the plan for the rest of stuff has pretty much been finalized!

[h3]Updated stuff![/h3]

Besides having a new chapter done, there’s been a lot of polishing to other parts during this year! Take a look of some of the updated stuff here:

[u]Updated menu:[/u]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179817/0694d24446bce17e0a04b3e5568fbbc5ffb55676.gif[/img]

[u]Pixel talking animation:[/u]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179817/06ef1a958e12249edc014cacd097547e7d84a8f8.gif[/img]

[u]An “Ultimate attack!”:[/u]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179817/4a136c228bec87cdce4c7cd43361e099b0fc5059.gif[/img]

[u]A new dodge mechanic:[/u]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179817/01cea3f5146356743228f32feb538fec0fb6d728.gif[/img]


[h3]What’s next[/h3]

The game will feature a total of four chapters plus prologue and a short epilogue. That means there’s only one chapter remaining! However, the game still needs a lot of polishing. Even though the main story might be finished earlier, the game will be released at a later date. The date hasn’t been set in stone yet, but will be in the second half of 2025, depending on the time it takes to create the last chapter.

I’ve learned a lesson from the demo, and that is not to rush the release. I was unhappy with the initial release of the demo. I fixed most of the annoyances with the update 1.5, but I don’t want to do that again. This time, I want to deliver a complete product that doesn’t need updates. Oh, but don’t take that the wrong way. Updates will absolutely come whenever necessary. I just mean that I want to make sure there is no big need for updates by making the game good enough on release.

So, the development will continue on forward! I want to make more progress updates in the future, but we'll have to see if it'll work out. There will be announcements for the important stuff for sure. The focus has been on developing the game for the past year, and I haven't had enough motivation to write continuous updates about the progress.

[h3]The demo[/h3]

The demo is complete, as far as I am concerned. It represents the full game well enough, even though there will be some changes to the first two chapters in the full game.

(EDIT:) Uhh, Steam actually just published some new features for demos. Well, I might change something in the demo in the future. No promises though!

As for the JP translation, I’m taking my word back about that. There’s been some trouble with the translator, so I can’t say anything if it is coming or not. Might come out one day, or might not. We’ll see. I’ll publish another announcement if I hear something about it in the future. Better not get any hopes up though.

Anyway, that’s pretty much it. Only one chapter left! See you next year for the final teaser. Oh, and in about 1,5 years on the release!

[spoiler]Hey Ralph, can I lend your main theme? I promise I’ll make it sound different so that the teacher won’t notice it!
 - Alph[/spoiler]

notes.title: Chapter 2 of Slumberer's Universe is soon done!
notes.notes:
Hi!

It's not even been a year since the Demo release with Prologue and Chapter 1, but it sure feels like a long time. Having the experience from the previous chapters and motivation to try new things, this upcoming chapter is, in my opinion, so far the best one. 

Without spoiling anything, this chapter will focus more on the main story and drive that forward. The Chapter 1 was a bit 'meh' story-wise, and that will receive a rework along with Prologue! However, that won't come to the demo, except if I decide otherwise in the future.

Here's a small teaser:
[previewyoutube=ujpMaQmk3Tk;full][/previewyoutube]


A lot of QoL changes have been made once again along with the new content, mostly to the battle system. These changes won't be ported to the demo due to the radical amount of changes made to the core components. It'd take time to get all these features working on the Demo's branch. Because of that, the demo won't be receiving any major updates anymore. Bug fixes will of course be published if bugs were to be found.

Well then, it's time for Chapter 3 next!

[spoiler](Also, is there another translation coming???? I heard Ralph say something about 日本語. . . or did I? Who was Ralph once again? I can't remember...)
                       – Alph[/spoiler]

notes.title: Version 1.5 released! New content + QoL changes
notes.notes:
[h1]The UX update 1.5 has been released![/h1]

Hi! This new update has a lot of improvements to the user experience. A lot of bugs and other clunky stuff has been fixed, and on top of that, many new features have been added!


[h2]Features:[/h2]

These do not differ much from the initial announcement.

[h3]1. New content![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/cec0531e195e05b207901de63616f6d68fc559d4.png[/img]
Some new content, like the new beginning of the game, has been added! While it doesn't include chapter 2, there are some new secret areas for you to find in this update!

[h3]2. 16:9 support[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/2282729eb8537de433454bfc924fd6f58a6c3199.png[/img]
This is definitely the biggest change you'll see. I've ported the game from 4:3 to 16:9 to make it better on modern monitors. The game is [b]only[/b] going to support 16:9 from now on, due to it being too hard to maintain 4:3 support too.

[h3]3. Improved UI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/06b9fe04e5737e21d5db7e161f7dcced99e3ac1b.png[/img]
The UI is now consistent everywhere. The menus, title screen, battle system, text box and everything has been updated to follow the new UI guidelines! A lot of animations have been added too.

[h3]4. Improved battle system[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/acc30fa871f69f61a6bf6ccb951808c4ff3a9360.png[/img]
Some updates have been made to the battle system as well, featuring a combo system, new animations, and improvements to the dodge system. These changes will make the fighting experience much more fun! On top of that, the enemies have been balanced.

[h3]5. Other smaller (but not unimportant!) stuff[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/3239b78b4b677ffdc30905546132b8b8d3eabd6b.png[/img]
The graphics got a noticeable upgrade. They are much sharper than before! The soundtrack got a few updates, with one new, one remade and one improved song. On top of that, some optimizations have been made under the hood that will provide a faster and stabler, less buggy experience. There's been stuff done for easier and faster developing too.
There are a lot more minor improvements and/or fixes, but those aren't worth mentioning.



[h2]Q&A[/h2]

[h3]Are the saves compatible with the new version?[/h3]
Unfortunately no. The game has got so many changes that some things will be broken beyond playable in the upcoming update. You can keep playing with your old saves on the old version, or you can start from the beginning.

[h3]I don't like the new stuff. Can I revert to the old version?[/h3]
Sure! You can download the old version either by entering the beta 1.0.1 from Steam or downloading the old version from Itch or Gamejolt to keep using this version.

[h3]Is chapter 2 be released?[/h3]
Nope. Chapter 2 will be released with rest of the chapters in the future. The release date is still TBD and will take a few years at least.

[h3]Is Ralph featured in this update?[/h3]
Yes? No? Maybe????



That's all for now.

notes.title: Slumberer's Universe Demo has been released!
notes.notes:
The demo of Slumberer's Universe is now released! This is the biggest game project we've worked so far so it's quite a milestone.

Now, the demo only has the prologue and the first chapter. Let's discuss about what's next.

[h1]The future[/h1]

Okay, there's a lot of things to do. Here's a quick summary of what we've planned to do next and what will the full game include:


[h2]The upcoming full game[/h2]

Starting with the chapter amount, there's no precise information of how many of them will come in the full product. The estimate for those currently are 4 (apart from the prologue and possibly an epilogue). The rest of them will be published within the full release.

We're not sure when the full game is coming, but the current estimates are between 2024 and 2025. That, however, is a very rough estimate, and it [i]could[/i] come during 2023, but that right now seems very unlikely.

The price of the full game will also be decided when it's done. Might be free.


[h2]The demo[/h2]

The demo's complete right now. It won't receive any more feature updates or any other major changes. Sure, there will be bug fixes and other small patches but that's probably everything. And no, we're not releasing another demo with the upcoming chapters to the public.

You probably already have noticed that the game is only available for Windows right now. I'll start working on the MacOS and Linux releases soon. If you're using linux, you should be able to play the game with Proton without any issues too.
